world: a dark gothic tower under a huge full moon at night, ruined spires and arches, purple flowers growing over cracked stone, silver starlight and violet magic glow

b-imp.describe: a small black shadow imp familiar like a fluffy black cat with bat wings, big pointed ears, glowing violet eyes and a crescent-moon charm, sitting proudly

b-witch.describe: a beautiful moon-eating witch with long silver hair, a wide pointed black hat with crescent ornaments, a flowing black and violet gown with gold trim, holding a crescent-moon staff and a dark orb of void magic

b-maou.describe: a tall star-devouring demon king with long black hair and a jagged dark crown, dark ornate robes embroidered with silver stars and constellations, holding a black star orb in one hand, regal and menacing
